checks.operation: Open the isolated verification app connection settings with the default policy.
Parent runner changes the fixture device setting to true through the host API; inspect the already-open Android setting.
Parent runner restarts Android; inspect the retained true value.
Parent runner toggles the actual Android control to false; inspect the Android value.
Parent runner restarts Android; inspect the retained false value.
Parent runner restarts the fixture host and Android; inspect the retained false value.

limitations: UI operations, process restarts, API writes and the host assertion were performed by the parent runner. This audit directly reads and checks its six native-control captures.
The verification APK and synthetic localhost fixture are separate from production pairing and data.
This tests the policy value and its synchronization/persistence; it does not establish a plaintext connection across a real Wi-Fi LAN.
The security fixture uses its own Android and host restart sequence; it does not repeat the production offline-start sequence used for the other 29 settings.
Native Mac production settings were observed with the default false value; no native Mac security opt-in click is claimed.
